note: A look at embed.threads.picture-on-a-pin after n-0333 (Topher, 2026-09-21): the rule’s drop zone is its conversation block, a file over the application’s frame lights it, and a cover says what a drop does. Driven on a stamped scratch copy on 4730 (node tools/scratch.mjs new look-0921e).

results.reasoning: A file dragged over the application’s frame - never over the panel’s own window - lights the rule’s conversation block with a dashed outline and a cover reading “Drop the picture here / It goes with the next thing you say on this rule”; the rest of the pane stays as it was. Over the block the outline goes solid, the cover densifies and reads “Drop it”. Leaving the block falls back to dashed; the frame reporting the file gone clears it all. A drop on the block is held above the box and clears the cover. Text dragged over the frame lights nothing. The thread screen does the same with “It goes with your next reply”. The cover’s words stand on a chip of their own; a first pass had them straight over the conversation’s text, where they could not be read, and that was fixed before this was recorded.
